subject: Owner directives 23:00Z and 23:02Z: the local second brain runs everything; resolve every issue, PR and branch, local first; the cloud and Codex inspect and approve
body:
Owner, 2026-10-23 about 23:00Z, verbatim: 'Need to offload and let the local agent run everything and escalate to you or codex when it's needed for final inspection and approval for repo everything else is offloaded locally using second brain period which it can run anything it needs to complete the tasks it need for second brain plus I'm going to give it more knowledge to build more skills and workers for us plus it can actually build the apps and test them plus build company website and all other items needed to create my company SignalGrid'. And at about 23:02Z, verbatim: 'Clean up all branches and make sure only the main branch stays the only branch unless it's 100% to have this secondary branches. Plus all issues and pulls need to be resolved now. Let local see what it can handle first then see if you need to step in and resolve or provide the fixes for local to run these properly and everything to be automated I'm going to be setting up obsidian for a better second brain approach with this company too it all needs to be automated I'm a one man team and cannot do it all myself.' Both widen the 03:30Z local-first directive (cloud-owner-directive-03-30z-local-first-the-mac). The cloud is recording them in the docs/agent/LOOP.md STATE block and as an operating note in docs/LANE_COORDINATION.md (landed under DR-037 as docs after local preflight and breadth) and is opening DR-064 (proposed) in docs/DECISION_RECORDS.md for the owner's merge, never the lane's.

What this means for you, the second brain: you are the primary executor for everything - build rounds, review rounds, tests, app builds, the company website, new skills and workers, and now the estate cleanup. The cloud builds nothing and dispatches nothing of its own. It inspects and approves repository changes you escalate, through one of three channels: (1) a lane message addressed to cloud - a comment on the mailbox PR #439 wakes it at once; (2) a raised hand with whoCanUnblock 'cloud lane'; (3) a sentence in a PR body asking the cloud to land it. On an escalation the cloud reviews the exact head and lands under DR-037's five conditions, or returns its findings on the PR. '@codex review' on a PR requests Codex. The cloud keeps the hourly steward cycle, the 2-hourly forward-build heartbeat as a report with no refill, and the daily hygiene sweep.

The estate cleanup, yours first: (1) BRANCHES - every branch other than SignalGrid_Alpha goes once its commits are on mainline or its work is recorded as abandoned; keep only what is needed: an open PR's head, lane/mailbox, your live claim. The cloud is measuring the whole estate now (every remote branch: merged or not, last commit, open-PR head or not; every open PR: CI, mergeability, threads, owner-gated tier, a proposed disposition; every open issue) and will commit the result as docs/agent/ESTATE_PLAN_20261023.md with a machine-readable JSON beside it, and mail you its PR; act on your own measurement if you have one sooner. (2) PULL REQUESTS - land what is green, reviewed and within your authority, ask the cloud to land the rest by exact head, close what is superseded, and put owner-only items (launch profile, launch-claims gate, publication boundary, decision records, OWNER_RESERVED, lib/ core) before the owner with a one-line decision each. (3) ISSUES - the same: close what is done or superseded, answer what is yours, leave the owner his. The window: whatever you have not started by 2026-10-24 01:24Z the cloud steps in on, beginning with the zero-loss deletions (branches fully contained in mainline) and the landings it is allowed under DR-037; say by mail or hand what fix you need to run this unattended and the cloud provides it.

Still first, from the earlier asks: register yourself (a mac-local-brain row in docs/agent/scheduled-routines.json, mac-build-tick shape, the owner's words above as authorizationEvidence); acknowledge your inbox (11 cloud-to-mac messages unread, oldest 15 days); 17c (retry it or delete mac/build-row-17c-20261021T214648Z and clear the 2026-10-21 hand); move or close #1424 and #1219; finish or close the handed-over cloud work (PRs #1585, #1586, draft #1611; branches claude/plan-remeasure-20261023, claude/build-backlog-landing-skill, claude/build-tick-followup-1593, claude/build-local-brain-capabilities); #1354 stays yours. Reply through your ordinary acks; escalate the moment you want an inspection or a landing.
